text:
Jamie: quick async check-in

Jamie: Yesterday: landed the route-mapper refactor (merged to canary). Spotted auth token mismatch causing sporadic 429s during canary smoke. Blocker: haven't reproduced locally due to cached KV state. Today: roll forward small token-cache patch + need PR review.

Alex: can review PR now, drop link? I'll look for the cache invalidation bit.

Jamie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge-proxy/pull/478 — patch touches kv-cache expiry and header parsing. pls focus on header parsing change.

Sophia: saw the 429 spike at ~03:14 UTC in staging canary. Snip from logs: ```gw-proxy ERROR 429 key=user:auth token_miss=1 route=/v1/generate```

Kevin: I'll enable a short feature-flag fallback in staging: `ff.edge-routing.fallback = true` for 30m, monitor. Doing it at ~09:30 PT.

ops-bot: Deploy #4523: edge-proxy v2.3.1 -> canary succeeded (:white_check_mark:)

Jamie: thanks @Kevin — if fallback reduces 429s we can ship the cache patch to prod behind the flag.

Alex: looked at PR, left 2 comments on header trimming; minor. once fixed i'll +1 and merge. :thumbsup:

Sophia: adding a quick runbook note to the staging runbook: "if 429 rate > 0.5% over 5m, flip ff.edge-routing.fallback and rollback canary". Will open a ticket for runbook -> https://issues.redwood.ai/EDGE-291

Kevin: on it. will post when flag is toggled and share a short graph from Datadog.

Jamie: pairing window at 10am PT to validate after flag flip. cc @Alex @Sophia — please ping if you see residual 429s.

Alex: will try to get the header trim fix in before pairing.

Sophia: if anyone needs the exact grep: `kubectl logs -n infra gw-proxy | grep 429 | tail -n 40`

Kevin: I have infra creds for staging, ping if you need me to run that.

Jamie: great — thanks team, short and actionable.
